spec.description: DigitalOcean droplet running the fantasy hockey app: host, app, proxy (Caddy), containers and logs. Every query filters on environment="digital-ocean" and the selected stage, except Certificate Expires In, which reads the Synthetic Monitoring check (no such labels) by its job and instance. No alert rules.
Whether Alloy can scrape the app at localhost:8080/metrics (up of job fantasy-hockey).
spec.title: App

spec.description: Whether Alloy can scrape cAdvisor at localhost:9110 (up of job integrations/cadvisor).
spec.title: cAdvisor

spec.description: Time since the droplet booted.
spec.title: Uptime

spec.description: CPU busy share across all cores (everything but idle).
spec.title: CPU

spec.description: Memory in use: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal.
spec.title: Memory

spec.description: Swap in use (swap file). Linux keeps pages in swap after memory pressure ends, so a high value alone is not a shortage; a rising value is.
spec.title: Swap Used

spec.expr: max(1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/node_exporter", mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/node_exporter", mountpoint="/"})

spec.description: Used share of the root filesystem (/). Resizing the droplet does not grow the disk.
spec.title: Root Disk

spec.expr: max(1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/node_exporter", mountpoint=~"/mnt/.+_data"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/node_exporter", mountpoint=~"/mnt/.+_data"})

spec.description: Used share of the data volume (/mnt/<droplet_name>_data) that holds the app data. Red "No data" when the volume is not mounted, or when Alloy or node exporter sends nothing.
spec.title: Volume Disk

spec.expr: avg by (instance, mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/node_exporter", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: CPU time per mode as a share of all cores, idle left out.
spec.title: CPU by Mode

spec.description: Memory used (MemTotal - MemAvailable) and swap used against their totals.
spec.title: Memory and Swap

spec.description: Used share of each filesystem.
spec.title: Disk Usage per Mount Point

spec.description: Bytes read from and written to each block device.
spec.title: Disk I/O

spec.description: Bytes received and transmitted per host interface (loopback and Docker bridges left out).
spec.title: Network

spec.description: Load average over 1, 5 and 15 minutes.
spec.title: Load

spec.description: HTTP requests per second per route, without the Alloy scrape of GET /metrics.
spec.title: Request Rate by Route

spec.description: HTTP requests per second per status code, without the Alloy scrape of GET /metrics.
spec.title: Request Rate by Status

spec.expr: sum by (route) (rate(fantasy_hockey_http_requests_total{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="fantasy-hockey", route!="GET /metrics", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Server errors (status 5xx) per second per route, without GET /metrics, from the app's own metrics. Empty when there were no 5xx responses. Responses Caddy answers itself (502 while the app is down or unreachable) are not counted here: see Proxy 5xx in the Proxy row.
spec.title: 5xx Rate

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(fantasy_hockey_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="fantasy-hockey", route!="GET /metrics"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(fantasy_hockey_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="fantasy-hockey", route!="GET /metrics"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description: Request duration quantiles across all routes, without GET /metrics.
spec.title: Latency p50 / p95

spec.description: Login events per time bucket, by event.
spec.title: Login Events

spec.description: Saved predictions per time bucket, by kind.
spec.title: Prediction Saves

spec.description: Resident memory of the app process and the Go heap in use.
spec.title: Process Memory

spec.description: Number of goroutines in the app process.
spec.title: Goroutines

spec.expr: sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/cadvisor", name=~"$container", name!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: CPU used per container as a share of one core (cAdvisor).
spec.title: Container CPU

spec.expr: sum by (name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/cadvisor", name=~"$container", name!=""})

spec.description: Working set memory per container (cAdvisor).
spec.title: Container Memory (Working Set)

spec.expr: sum by (name) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/cadvisor", name=~"$container", name!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (name) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/cadvisor", name=~"$container", name!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Bytes received and transmitted per container (cAdvisor).
spec.title: Container Network

spec.description: stdout and stderr of the Docker containers selected in $container.
spec.title: Container Logs

spec.description: systemd journal of the droplet (label unit holds the systemd unit).
spec.title: Journal Logs

spec.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/docker", container=~".+-caddy", log_type="access"} | json status [$__auto]))

spec.description: Requests Caddy answered on the app's domain per interval, by HTTP status, from Caddy's access log (log_type="access"). Counts every response Caddy sends, the 404 for /metrics and its own 502 while the app is down included. Requests to the reserved IP on http:// are not logged and not counted.
spec.title: Requests by Status

spec.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/docker", container=~".+-caddy", log_type="access"} | json status | status=~"5.." [$__auto]))

spec.description: Server errors (status 5xx) per interval as Caddy sees them, from its access log. Unlike the App row's 5xx Rate this includes the 502 Caddy answers itself while the app is down or unreachable; Caddy then also writes a proxy error (logger http.log.error) to the Operational Log. Empty when there were no 5xx responses.
spec.title: Proxy 5xx

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/docker", container=~".+-caddy", log_type="access"} | json duration | __error__="" | unwrap duration | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (stage)

spec.description: 95th percentile of the time Caddy took per request (field duration of the access log, in seconds), proxying to the app included. Gaps mean no requests in the interval.
spec.title: Proxy Duration p95

spec.expr: topk(10, sum by (path) (count_over_time({environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/docker", container=~".+-caddy", log_type="access"} | json uri="request.uri" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "[?].*" .uri "" }}` [$__range])))

spec.description: The 10 most requested paths in the time range, from Caddy's access log, with the query string stripped. Includes paths that scanners try on the domain.
spec.title: Top Paths

spec.description: Caddy's lines that are neither access nor certificate lines (log_type="operational"): startup and config lines, the proxy errors (logger http.log.error, for example "connection refused" while the app is down) and any line that is not JSON.
spec.title: Operational Log

spec.description: Caddy's certificate lines (log_type="tls", loggers tls..., http.acme_client... and pki...). Caddy 2.11.7 logs tls.obtain when it obtains a certificate and tls.cache.maintenance and tls storage cleaning in between. Renewal lines appear only around a renewal: Caddy renews when about a third of the certificate's lifetime is left (about 30 days for a Let's Encrypt certificate).
spec.title: Certificate Events

spec.description: Days until the certificate served on https://fantasy-hockey.<stage>.do.sommerfeld.app expires, as the Synthetic Monitoring check (job up-and-running___digital-ocean, Story 5.2) sees it from outside; the lowest value of its probes. Synthetic Monitoring series carry no environment or stage label, so this query filters by the check's job and instance. Caddy renews when about 30 days are left (orange below 30, red below 14). Red No data: the check has no recent result.
spec.title: Certificate Expires In

spec.expr: sum by (level) (count_over_time({environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/docker", container=~".+-caddy", log_type="access"} | json level [$__auto]))

spec.description: Access log lines Caddy wrote per interval, by the field level. A response with status 5xx is logged at level error (a 502 while the app is down shows up here as error).
spec.title: Access Log Lines by Level

spec.expr: sum by (stream) (count_over_time({environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/docker", container=~".+-caddy", stream=~".+"} [$__auto]))

spec.description: All lines of the Caddy container per interval, by Docker output stream (label stream). Caddy writes all its logs to stderr, so stdout is expected to stay at or near zero.
spec.title: Caddy Log Lines by Stream

spec.expr: sum by (level) (count_over_time({environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/docker", container=~".+-caddy", log_type="access"} | json level [$__range]))

spec.description: Share of the access log lines per level over the dashboard time range.
spec.title: Access Log Levels

spec.expr: sum by (stream) (count_over_time({environment="digital-ocean", stage=~"$stage", job="integrations/docker", container=~".+-caddy", stream=~".+"} [$__range]))

spec.description: Share of the Caddy container's lines per Docker output stream over the dashboard time range. Caddy logs to stderr, so stdout is expected to be absent or tiny.
spec.title: Caddy Output Streams
Apps / Fantasy Hockey / Droplet
